items.text: Malik Nabers active after late decision ~2hrs pre-kick; family skipped due to uncertainty. Played first game since ACL+meniscus.
items.why: Knee Q; full practice but decided late; felt good postgame
items.implication: Cleared return; healthy exit boosts ROS
items.opportunity: High target share on limited snaps

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) left early Sunday; ETR watching as key injury. Rapoport: not serious, day-to-day, MRI, would have returned if playoff/close game. Coach confirms day-to-day.
items.why: Hamstring exit Q2 after 5-150-1; sources say not serious
items.implication: Monitor practice; possible Week 2 sit or limited
items.opportunity: Hamstring day-to-day could free targets if out

items.text: AJ Brown high ankle sprain: no surgery needed but sidelined 4-6 weeks; placed on IR.
items.why: Ankle in Wed game; 4-6 wks no surgery

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY Sunday; status linked to Etienne projection.
items.implication: Saints RB committee opens; Etienne lead but not full dominate

items.text: Ladd McConkey (chest/rib) left early after big hit, did not return. ETR watching; Harbaugh no immediate update.
items.why: Chest injury Q3 after 5-82-1; questionable then out rest of game
items.implication: Week 2 status TBD on practice; LAC WR depth thinned

items.text: Surprised Etienne didn't dominate more with Kamara out: snaps 53/Et 26 Miller/15 Donaldson; routes 24/5/7; opps 18/9/4.
items.implication: Etienne not pure RB1 lock; monitor split ROS
items.opportunity: Still lead back; Miller handcuff value

items.text: Nabers post-ACL return: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: Limited but efficient target monster; no setback
items.implication: Startable WR1/2 with volume upside as snaps rise

items.text: Ja'Kobi Lane ruled out wrist injury; fractured, miss several weeks.
items.implication: Ravens WR depth hit; Flowers already banged

items.text: Brock Bowers (meniscus trim Tue) out Week 1; realistic chance miss only 1 game, return Week 2 vs LAC possible.
items.why: Meniscus procedure; team optimistic short miss

items.text: Weekend reports: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) and Rome Odunze (calf) EXPECTED TO PLAY.
items.implication: Startable if cleared; Love RB2 upside

items.text: Dalton Kincaid over PCL: 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Allen dropbacks (69%). Moves needle when healthy.
Panthers RB: Hubbard 48 snaps/25 routes/13 opps vs Brooks 13/5/6. Brooks early-week side work on alleged groin.
items.why: Clear Hubbard lead; Brooks limited possibly tweak
items.implication: Hubbard RB2/flex lock; Brooks handcuff only

items.text: Isaiah Likely breakout SZN well under way after Week 1.
items.why: Strong Week 1 production amid Ravens TE/WR flux

items.text: Buy low on Colston Loveland; still want Bears offense share despite Week 1. Concern flagged in recap.
items.why: Preseason belief in Bears pass-catchers unchanged; Week 1 weirdness
